scope: A-grade trainer durability: prevent GPU saturation controller from increasing optimizer epochs after out-of-sample validation regression

defect.summary: The adaptive GPU controller raised steps_multiplier for CPU-prep bottlenecks even after the checkpoint promotion guard rejected a candidate for validation loss regression.
defect.impact: The trainer could keep running too many optimizer steps, repeatedly producing non-durable candidates instead of backing off toward smaller validation-safe updates.

expected_next_cycle.goal: attempt smaller real training update; still require checkpoint promotion guard to pass before durable weights are written

a_grade_status.reason: This repairs a training-loop controller defect. A-grade still requires strict holdout and closed economic evidence; no thresholds were lowered.
